headline: Route Mobile Q2FY27 Results: Net Profit Up 120% YoY
summary: Route Mobile reported a consolidated net profit of ₹82.55 crore for Q2FY27, up 120% YoY. Revenue rose 5.4% to ₹1,179.67 crore. Board declared ₹4 interim dividend.

headline: Quick Heal Q2FY27 PAT up 210% QoQ
summary: Quick Heal Technologies reported a profit after tax of ₹5.80 crore in Q2FY27, a 209.7% quarter-on-quarter rise. Revenue stood at ₹64.93 crore, down 22.3% YoY.

headline: Jonjua Overseas board to meet Nov 5 on fundraising
summary: Jonjua Overseas Limited scheduled a board meeting for November 5, 2026, to review fundraising recommendations and assess financing requirements.

headline: Gandhar Q2 results: profit dips, revenue rises QoQ
summary: Gandhar's Q2 consolidated net profit fell to 1.75b rupees from 1.92b rupees QoQ, while revenue rose to 18.47b rupees from 17.3b rupees. EBITDA margin contracted to 15.56% from 16.27% QoQ.

headline: TBZ Q2 results: net profit falls 50% YoY
summary: TBZ reported Q2 net profit of 154m rupees, down from 307m rupees YoY. Revenue rose to 7.05b rupees from 6.9b rupees, while EBITDA margin contracted sharply to 6.67% from 16.30%.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: Raymond, PGEL, ABDL, FDC in focus
summary: Raymond rallies 2.45% on 131% profit jump. PG Electroplast surges 5.38% on stellar Q2 results. Allied Blenders gains 3.29% as volumes hit record highs.

headline: Bajaj Auto targets 80k monthly EV capacity
summary: Bajaj Auto plans to increase Chetak EV production to 80,000 units monthly by Q4. Total manufacturing capacity will rise to 775,000 units annually.

headline: Velan Hotels gets ROC notice for filing delay
summary: Velan Hotels Ltd received an adjudication notice from ROC Coimbatore for a 17-day delay in filing e-Form MR-1. The company states no material impact on operations.

headline: Nomura upgrades IndiaMART to Neutral, target ₹1,840
summary: Nomura upgraded IndiaMART to Neutral with a target price of ₹1,840, noting subscriber additions declined slightly in Q2 and flagging falling unique business enquiries as a key downside risk.

headline: Oracle Financial Services may extend staff separation plan
summary: Oracle Financial Services may expand its voluntary staff separation plan to India amid global workforce restructuring driven by increasing AI investments, offering eligible managers at least six weeks' severance pay.

headline: Jain Irrigation signs 19,000 tonne biochar deal
summary: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd. partners with Supercritical to supply up to 19,000 tonnes of biochar carbon removal credits for 2026-27, leveraging its Jalgaon facility.

headline: AksharChem seeks shareholder nod for MD re-appointment
summary: AksharChem (India) Ltd has issued a postal ballot notice for the re-appointment of Munjal M. Jaykrishna as MD & CEO and revisions for Sachin M. Jaykrishna. Voting runs from October 29 to November 27, 2026.

headline: Hindustan Unilever Q2 net profit rises to ₹28.4B
summary: Hindustan Unilever reported Q2 net profit of ₹28.4 billion, up from ₹26.9 billion YoY. Revenue rose to ₹174 billion, while EBITDA margin contracted to 22.75%.

headline: LTM launches GCC Origin for AI-native capability centers
summary: LTM Ltd has launched GCC Origin, a new business unit to help enterprises build and transform Global Capability Centers in India using AI-driven models.

headline: Avenue Supermarts shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,47,971 Avenue Supermarts shares changing hands on NSE at ₹3,128.40, with a combined value of ₹77.58 crore.

headline: Modison develops silver-tungsten carbide contacts for railways
summary: Modison Limited has developed Silver-Tungsten Carbide electrical contacts for railway signalling relays, targeting a ₹250 crore domestic market opportunity.

headline: PG Electroplast targets 1.5 million compressor units by 2027
summary: PG Electroplast plans to begin mass production of its compressor project by January-February, with a target of over 1.5 million units in 2027.
